What every prophet taught

God alone

The firmest handhold begins with a no to every false god, and then a yes to God.

A hand must open before it can hold on. The Quran gives the order: turn from every false god, then believe in God, and you have the firmest handhold. The Ten Commandments open by clearing the same ground, and the prophets' sentence starts there: no god, then God. A false god can be whatever enslaves the heart in God's place: money, desire, fame. Letting go is how we become free.

﴿لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become distinct from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in ṭāghūt and believes in Allāh has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:256

﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:25

﴿أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَـٰوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?

Quran · Al-Jathiyah 45:23

You might ask

QuestionWhy begin with a no?
AnswerBecause a full heart has no room. Both halves came with every messenger: worship God, and keep away from false gods.Quran · An-Nahl 16:36
QuestionCan money or fame really become a god?
AnswerThe Quran speaks of one who makes desire their god. Money and fame can sit on the same seat. Ask what you obey first, even against your conscience.Quran · Al-Jathiyah 45:23
QuestionIs this aimed at other people's religions?
AnswerNo people is named here. The question goes to every heart, ours first: what rules me? And no one is forced: the same verse opens with that.Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:256

Let go of what enslaves you, and your hands are free to hold on to God.
